children: The Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund
is approaching a key support level at $182, where volume-weighted average price measures tied to the recent trading range converge.

XLK was around $183.93 on a chart posted by Alfonso De Pablos, director of research at All Star Charts, leaving the technology ETF close to the level that could become an important test for its recent consolidation.
Pablos said the $182 area represented a significant support zone because the VWAP measures based on the range's high and low meet there.
"The big level I’m watching for Technology $XLK is 182. That’s where the VWAPs anchored to the range’s high and low come together, creating a major confluence of support," Pablos posted.
The chart showed XLK surging from around $128 in March to nearly $199 in April-May before pulling back sharply. The ETF then fell to around $167 in July before recovering.
Since that July low, XLK has largely consolidated between roughly $178 and $190, with the $182 area now emerging as a key level within that range.
A break below $182 could put the recent consolidation under pressure, while holding above the level would keep the current range intact.

title: XLK hovers above the level that matters most
